execution_scope: metadata regeneration from saved results; no fit/predict executed in this invocation

cv.january_role: development and candidate comparison, not an independent blind test
cv.representation_scope: H05 mapping fitted once on all October; conditional group CV. Imputation/scaling/encoding and LR fit within each fold; clustering is not refitted per fold.
cv.selection_metric: January Top10% hits informed development comparison. CV summaries are separate internal diagnostics.

ranking: score descending, customer_unique_id ascending for ties

group_models.representation_scope: H05 mapping fitted once on all October; conditional group CV. Imputation/scaling/encoding and LR fit within each fold; clustering is not refitted per fold.

methods.B_global_with_cluster: Global weighted LR with categorical cluster_id
methods.C_segmented_group2_global_fallback: Separate weighted LR for groups0/1, global model for group2; fallback to global if a training group has one class
